Callout.Name: Silent 911 Call
Callout.Message: Open line to 911, nothing said, address confirmed.
Callout.Advisory: Line still open, background noise only.

Script.Line: I cannot talk. He is in the next room and he is awake.
The address is right. Just come to the address.
Please do not knock. Please do not knock loud.

Lines.Approach: The line is open and nobody is talking. Could be a mistake, could be the opposite.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
